html:
Ninh Binh is not only famous for its breathtaking landscapes but also for its rich and distinctive cuisine. Influenced by local ingredients, traditional cooking methods, and regional culture, Ninh Binh’s food offers a unique culinary experience that every traveler should explore.

If you are planning a trip, here are the must try specialties that will make your journey even more memorable.

Ninh Binh Goat Meat (Dê Núi)

Goat meat is the most iconic dish of Ninh Binh and a highlight of local cuisine. The goats are raised freely on limestone mountains, which gives the meat a firm texture and naturally rich flavor.

There are many ways to enjoy goat meat, including grilled goat, steamed goat, goat hotpot, and rare goat with lemon. It is often served with fresh herbs and a special dipping sauce made from fermented soybean paste, creating a bold and unforgettable taste.

Crispy Rice (Cơm Cháy)

Cơm cháy is another famous specialty that you should not miss. This dish is made from fried rice crust, creating a crispy and golden texture.

It is typically served with a savory sauce made from pork, beef, or goat meat. The combination of crunchy rice and rich sauce makes it a popular dish among both locals and tourists.

Cơm cháy is also a popular souvenir that travelers can take home.

Mountain Snails (Ốc Núi)

Mountain snails are a unique and seasonal delicacy found in limestone areas.

They are typically prepared by steaming with lemongrass or stir-frying with herbs. The meat is chewy and slightly sweet, offering a distinctive taste that reflects the natural environment of Ninh Binh.

Eel Vermicelli (Miến Lươn)

Eel vermicelli is a flavorful dish that combines soft glass noodles with well-seasoned eel.

The eel is usually stir-fried or served in a light broth, creating a balance between richness and freshness. This dish is both nutritious and satisfying, making it a great choice for a local meal.

Freshwater Fish Dishes

With its dense river system, Ninh Binh offers a variety of freshwater fish dishes. Fish can be grilled, braised, or cooked in soups, preserving their natural sweetness.

These dishes are simple yet flavorful, reflecting the local cooking style.

Fermented Pork Roll (Nem Yên Mạc)

Nem Yên Mạc is a traditional fermented pork dish originating from Yên Mạc village.

The pork is finely processed, mixed with spices, and wrapped in leaves to ferment naturally. The result is a mildly sour, aromatic dish often served with herbs and dipping sauce.

Burnt Fermented Pork (Thịt Cháy Cạnh)

This traditional dish features pork that is slightly charred on the outside, creating a smoky aroma while remaining tender inside.

It is often served with rice and dipping sauce, offering a rich and satisfying flavor.

Where to Enjoy Ninh Binh Cuisine

Local restaurants in Tam Coc, Trang An, and Ninh Binh city are great places to try these specialties.

For a more authentic experience, travelers can also dine at local eateries or homestays, where dishes are prepared using traditional recipes.

Travel Tips for Food Lovers

Try different cooking styles of the same dish, especially goat meat.

Choose reputable restaurants to ensure food quality and hygiene.

Combine food experiences with sightseeing for a more complete journey.
